integrity: Exact integer arithmetic verifier bundled; finite tests supplement a proof, and an independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proves real-rootedness for 3D Cartesian prisms over full-dimensional planar lattice polygons, not all 3D lattice polytopes. Only the three nonreal-rooted planar h-star cases require new cubic discriminants; remaining cases use a published Wagner product theorem. Priority is best-knowledge and not independent confirmation.
title: Every lattice-polygon prism has a real-rooted Ehrhart numerator
